definition: Jubatus is an open-source online machine learning and distributed computing framework developed at Nippon Telegraph and Telephone and Preferred Infrastructure.
details: Its features include classification, recommendation, regression, anomaly detection and graph mining. It supports many client languages, including C++, Java, Ruby and Python. It uses Iterative Parameter Mixture for distributed machine learning.
story: Imagine a driving test that every new model has to pass before it is allowed on the road. It is the exam that separates “it sounds good” from “it actually is good”. A fair scoreboard keeps everyone honest. It is the exam that keeps everyone honest. And that, done honestly, is Jubatus.
